ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, in $\triangle ABC$, $\angle ACD=110^\circ$, $\angle B=30^\circ$, then what is the measure of $\angle A$ in degrees?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since $\angle ACD$ is an exterior angle of $\triangle ABC$,\\
therefore $\angle ACD = \angle A + \angle B$,\\
thus $\angle A = 110^\circ - 30^\circ = \boxed{80^\circ}$.
